item.title: The missing digit of Stela C
item.description:
📝 In the Meso-American Long Count calendar this corresponds to September 3, 32 BC. Like the Mayans, they used the Mesoamerican Long Count Calendar. Experts believe they know: September 6, 3114 BCE in the proleptic Julian calendar, where ‘proleptic’ means roughly that we’re extrapolating this calendar back to times long before anyone used this calendar.
